source: Yahoo Finance option chains via yfinance (delayed ~15 min)

notes.inferred: Inferred net premium from live delayed snapshots (incremental, locked-in classification of each snapshot's new volume vs that snapshot's bid/ask); available from 2026-10-28.
notes.occ_cp: OCC cleared contract volume, calls vs puts, completed sessions only. No side, no premium.

sources.Yahoo: Yahoo Finance quote data via yfinance (earningsTimestampStart, isEarningsDateEstimate, call time)
